title: Hand-judged local-docs retrieval eval
description: 18 real questions this project has actually needed answered. Each relevant_chunk_id was read in the live index and contains the answer, not merely a topical mention. top_k=5 is search_docs' default; a relevant chunk at rank 6-50 is the FlashRank signal (Stage 3 only reorders Hybrid's fused head). A miss entirely outside the scorer pool is a Stage 4 rewrite problem, not a reranker problem. TODO.md and RAG_EVALUATION.md are not in SOURCE_GLOBS — ground truth is only indexed files.

queries.query: How do parallel agents pick the next changelog filename letter?
queries.intent: 2026-09-02w collision: two agents both chose u. Need YYYY-MM-DDx plus scripts/next_changelog_id.py.

queries.query: What must a factual claim from project documents cite?
queries.intent: Agent citation rules: path and heading, not a generic 'cite sources' lecture.

queries.query: Is FlashRank the default docs search now?
queries.intent: Default is HybridScorer; FlashRank was deferred and not installed.

queries.query: Which FlashRank model names are actually in the catalog?
queries.intent: TinyBERT-L-2-v2 and MiniLM-L-12-v2. L-6-v2 is not in the catalog — 2026-09-02m named it wrongly.

queries.query: Why can search_docs run from several threads in the same hop?
queries.intent: CONCURRENCY_SAFE_TOOLS plus the unlocked _INDEX_CACHE race that 2026-08-31d fixed.

queries.query: Is agentic_search_docs safe to run in parallel with search_docs?
queries.intent: Separate tool, PROJECT_ONLY_TOOLS, not CONCURRENCY_SAFE_TOOLS because it calls the model.

queries.query: What local-docs tool retries with rewritten queries when the first hits are weak?
queries.intent: agentic_search_docs: retrieve, model-grade, retry up to MAX_ROUNDS=3, strip invented citations.

queries.query: Where can I read farm worker liveness without calling Celery inspect live?
queries.intent: farm_status.json snapshot daemon, not a live inspect() on every read.

queries.query: Did we stay on Ollama or switch the agent to PowerInfer?
queries.intent: Phase 1 closed: stay on Qwen/gpt-oss via Ollama. No PowerInfer route, no TinyChatEngine intake now.

queries.query: If search_docs returns nothing, may the agent answer from training anyway?
queries.intent: Empty fused pool means local docs do not establish the claim. MIN_EMBED_SIMILARITY=0.35 exists so RRF cannot return 'closest anyway'.

queries.query: Speech came back slurred — should I reroll the seed or change the duration?
queries.intent: Gibberish/mispronunciation → duration ladder, seed held fixed. Seed is the wrong-voice knob only.

queries.query: At what context fill fraction does compaction prefetch start?
queries.intent: PROACTIVE_THRESHOLD = 0.80 of num_ctx, not at overflow.

queries.query: Why did GPU chat fall back to the CPU 8B when VRAM was almost empty?
queries.intent: GPU Ollama :11434 was down (Case B). VRAM 73 MB was below VRAM_BUSY_MB=2500; routing itself was correct.

queries.query: Why did the first judge_transcript batch fail as NotRegistered?
queries.intent: Mac worker_farm code predated 2026-09-02c; old tasks.py had no judge_transcript.

queries.query: How does the workstation send embed jobs to the farm without importing Celery?
queries.intent: farm_offload spawns worker_farm/.venv Python running _farm_submit_wait.py; returns None, never raises.

queries.query: If ping to the WireGuard hub fails, is the farm down?
queries.intent: ICMP to 10.90.90.1 can fail on Windows firewall while TCP/SSH/Celery work. Do not treat ping as the health signal.

queries.query: Is ReluLLaMA eligible for the production model picker?
queries.intent: Failed 9/10 instruction-format cases; diagnostic-only, not registry/picker/routing.

queries.query: Can the literal tinyengine package run on the RTX 5080?
queries.intent: mit-han-lab/tinyengine is microcontroller-only. The desktop sibling is TinyChatEngine; that was inferred, not stated.
